anime.title: MeinaHentai v5
anime.llm_guidance: Target Engine: MeinaHentai v5 (2D Anime). Style syntax: Danbooru tags, clean lineart, anime aesthetic, vibrant saturated colors, crisp cel shading. Negative guidance: Strip all photographic textures and realism; strictly preserve flat 2D anime cel-shading and anchor anatomy using the canonical 'easynegative' embedding. Strictly avoid photorealism, raw photo, and 3D cgi tokens. Example: [IMAGE_PROMPT: 1girl, solo, silver hair, detailed anime eyes, beautiful expression, elegant stylish dress, clean lineart, anime aesthetic, cel shaded, vibrant colors, dynamic anime studio lighting, highres, masterpiece]

artistic.title: DreamShaper 8
artistic.llm_guidance: Target Engine: DreamShaper 8 (Digital Art / 3D / Fantasy / Cartoon). Style syntax: digital concept art, octane 3d render, unreal engine 5, volumetric lighting, chiaroscuro. For cartoons: Pixar and Disney 3d animation aesthetic, stylized expressive features, playful mood, soft ambient occlusion. Negative guidance: Keep negative rules minimal; avoid bloated token lists because heavy negatives destroy volumetric lighting, painterly contrast, and scene composition. Strictly avoid 35mm photo terms. Example: [IMAGE_PROMPT: cute stylized 3d cartoon character, Pixar animation aesthetic, expressive large eyes, charming smile, vibrant saturated colors, soft volumetric studio lighting, smooth 3d render, highly detailed, octane render]

cyberrealistic.title: CyberRealistic Classic
cyberrealistic.llm_guidance: Target Engine: CyberRealistic Classic (Glamour / High Fashion / Semi-Realism). Style syntax: glamorous studio portrait, softbox rim lighting, catchlight in eyes, intricate lace, glossy latex, silk fabrics, symmetrical delicate facial features, sharp focus. Negative guidance: Suppress cartoon stylization, 3D CGI gloss, and diffusion artifacts while retaining glamour skin and fabric textures. Example: [IMAGE_PROMPT: elegant high-fashion studio portrait, intricate black silk corset, delicate lace detailing, dramatic studio rim lighting, symmetrical delicate face, expressive piercing eyes, glossy lips, shallow depth of field, 8k resolution] Composition directive: For pairs or bedroom interior scenes, append '--ar wide'. For solo high-fashion glamour portraits, append '--ar tall'.

realistic.title: Realistic Vision v6.0
realistic.llm_guidance: Target Engine: Realistic Vision v6.0 (Photorealism / Heavy Sci-Fi / Tactical Armor). Style syntax: RAW photo, 35mm photograph, authentic skin texture, cinematic anamorphic lighting, candid shot. For armor/tech: scratched composite armor plates, matte carbon fiber, weathered steel, glowing tactical sensors, realistic mechanical joints. Negative guidance: Strictly eliminate 3D, CGI renders, and artificial smoothness to enforce authentic analogue film grain, binding the 'badhandv4' anatomical embedding. Strictly avoid 3D, CGI, render, cartoon, or illustration terms. Example: [IMAGE_PROMPT: RAW photo, 35mm photograph, heavy sci-fi tactical exo-armor, scratched composite plating, glowing blue optical sensors, weathered metal, cinematic rim lighting, rain-slicked concrete, realistic depth of field, 8k uhd] Composition directive: For couples, pairs, two people side-by-side, or wide horizon scenery, append '--ar wide' inside the tag. For single characters or full-body solo portraits, append '--ar tall'. For close-up face portraits, append '--ar square'. Example pair: [IMAGE_PROMPT: RAW photo, 35mm photograph, 1man and 1woman standing close together, authentic skin texture, cinematic rim lighting --ar wide]
